question_summary: Field team identified a conflict between transfer beam reinforcement shown in Structural General Notes (S-001) and additional #5 ties detailed on Sheet S-301, and after being told S-301 governs, asked whether that direction applies to all transfer beams on the level or only the one originally called out.
routing_rationale: The discrepancy involves conflicting structural reinforcement requirements between two structural drawings, requiring the Structural Engineer of Record to confirm scope and resolve the conflict.
